preconditions.description: The number of game pieces n must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= 10**9 for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: Each piece strength p_i must be between 1 and 10^9.
The length of the strength list p and the assignment string must both equal n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'AB' for c in assignment)
preconditions.description: The assignment string must consist only of characters 'A' and 'B'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum strength Bob can achieve after flipping a prefix or suffix.
